title: Film test
description: A test bench for the lab's shared film look, shot through a circular polariser. A worm's-eye frame from the foot of a concrete utility pole, its crossarms and fanned wires leaning in towards the zenith in front of a towering summer cumulus, developed with halation, Pro-Mist diffusion, dye-cloud colour bleed, a film curve that lets the cloud glow instead of clip, fine grain and an optical vignette. Drag sideways to turn the polariser: the skylight's polarised share follows cos², so the sky deepens to cobalt and the cloud's skylit shade gains weight, then pales back to haze, half a turn per cycle.
intent: Tune the film kit against herb's references (scanned Portra 400 / Fuji Superia / CineStill summer skies), not a VHS or bloom filter. The polariser acts on the scene light before the film; the film's sky dye density follows the same cos² response. ?x=0..1 starting angle (0 = deepest sky), ?lift=0..1 holds the white-blue opening, ?preset=summer|dusk|night, any film param as a query override, ?motion=0 for still grain and no drift.
